title: Claude Code --channels Permission Relay Extension (v2.1.81)
description: Extension to the v2.1.80 --channels research preview. MCP channel servers that declare the 'permission' capability can now forward tool approval prompts to a remote device (e.g., phone via companion app). This enables human-in-the-loop approval for high-risk operations in headless/cron sessions without requiring Auto Mode's risk-based automation. Complementary to Auto Mode (auto-approve low-risk) — permission relay handles cases that need explicit human sign-off. Fills the gap: Auto Mode is all-or-nothing risk-based; permission relay provides selective remote approval.
redundancy_check: IMPROVEMENT — extends existing v2.1.80 --channels MONITOR entry. The base --channels feature is already in registry; this adds a specific permission relay capability that was not in the v2.1.80 entry. Warrants registry update.

evaluation.reasoning: Borderline approval at exactly 70.0. The permission relay fills a real gap: Auto Mode is all-or-nothing, but cron/headless sessions sometimes need selective human approval for specific high-risk operations. Extension to existing --channels (80 complexity) — no new infrastructure beyond what --channels already requires. Token efficiency neutral (50): no context savings, but eliminates polling-and-wait patterns for approval. Capability expansion (70): meaningful new capability within headless workflows, not a fundamental new capability class. Maintenance lower (60) due to research preview status — may change before GA. Official Anthropic (100 community). Integration action: update existing v2.1.80 --channels registry entry rather than creating a new entry. Hold full production adoption until --channels reaches GA.
evaluation.integration_action: REGISTRY UPDATE — update the existing v2.1.80 --channels MONITOR entry in registry/existing-capabilities.md to note permission relay capability. Do not create new registry section.
caveats: Still research preview — do not build production workflows around this yet
Requires companion app / MCP server that implements permission relay protocol
Re-evaluate when --channels reaches GA stable release
